info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contribution Models Retrieval API
info.description: The Contribution Models Retrieval API provides access to various contribution models used in banking services. This endpoint allows users to retrieve specific contribution model details by providing a unique identifier. It is designed for developers working on financial applications, enabling them to integrate banking models effectively. Typical consumers include financial institutions and software developers looking to enhance their applications with real-time banking functionalities.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific contribution model by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific contribution model using its unique identifier. The information returned will include all relevant attributes of the contribution model.
